background: Running in the background as job-{job}, writing its output to {path}. Read that file to see the output so far; a notice will arrive when the job ends.
timeout: Still running after {seconds}s, so it moved to the background as job-{job}, writing its output to {path}. Read that file to see the output so far; a notice will arrive when the job ends.
spill:
<persisted-output>
The whole output is in: {path}
Its last part:
{text}
</persisted-output>
notice:
<task-notification>
<task-id>job-{job}</task-id>
<tool-use-id>{call}</tool-use-id>
<output-file>{path}</output-file>
<status>{status}</status>
<summary>The background command "{description}" ended: {end}</summary>
</task-notification>
Read {path} for its output.
stopped: Nothing refused this command: the person stopped the turn while it was running, {seconds} s after it started, and Razor ended it.
generated:
Generated images are saved to {dir} as {path} by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The person sees the image only when you deliver it.
generated_large:
Generated images are saved to {dir} as {path} by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The person sees the image only when you deliver it.
It is over 7.5 MB, so it is saved but not shown to you.
image_gone: The image {path} can no longer be read, so it is not shown.
video_unsent: The video {path} could not be sent to the model: {error}
video_spent: (The video {path} was in an earlier turn and is no longer shown; ffmpeg can cut its frames for you to look at again.)
